pages.title: Carved stones and murals
text: The March wrote its own history down, in stone. **Carved Stones** are set into the walls of its ruins: the old works, the sunken shrine, the barrows, the tombs, the vaults. **Murals** stand two blocks wide and two tall at the guardians' grounds, each painting the country it stands in.

Right-click one and you read it; the fragment is kept here for good, and the Chronicle puts it in its place. There are **sixteen**: eight stones for the fall of the Loom, eight murals for the countries it left. Read them all and the Chronicle is whole.
The stones and murals can be picked up and set on any wall of your own, and a mural cut in creative changes its chapter with a sneak-click. Every chapter is a spoiler until you have found it.

pages.title: Paintings and crests
text: Six **paintings** of the March hang among the ordinary ones now: hold a painting to a wall and one may come up. Their titles are their own.
Each tribe hands its **crest** to its Kin: a banner pattern with the tribe's mark, for a loom and any dye. Fly it over a camp of your own and the tribe will know whose it is.
